caption:
Global Metadata: A smooth, mellow jazz piece, 96 BPM, laid-back swing feel in C major. A jazz trio of grand piano, upright bass, and brushed drums, joined by a warm tenor saxophone that takes the lead melody. It opens with the trio's relaxed walking-bass groove, the piano comps with soft chords, the tenor sax floats in with a smoky melodic line, they trade a few short phrases, then settle into a gentle piano solo over the bass and drums before a relaxed outro fade. Production profile: intimate small-club jazz recording, warm close miking on the sax and piano, soft and natural, studio mastering with generous dynamic range.

Vocal Details: No vocals at all. Purely instrumental jazz. Do not add any singing, scatting, or voice.

Arrangement: Intro, the trio sets a relaxed swing groove with walking upright bass, brushed drums, and soft piano comping. Section one, the warm tenor saxophone enters with the lead melody, floating and smoky over the trio. Section two, the sax trades short phrases with the piano, playful and relaxed. Section three, a gentle piano solo over the bass and drums. Outro, the full trio and sax ease into a calm fade. Smooth, clean tone throughout.
